##  Search Your AO Code
It is mandatory for the applicants to mention the AO code in the PAN application. The AO code under jurisdiction of which the applicant falls, should be selected by the applicant. The applicants are advised to be careful in selection of the AO code. The details given here are as per the information received from the Income Tax Department. For additional information applicants may contact local office of Income Tax Department or call Aaykar Sampark Kendra on 0124-2438000.
  * [PAN AO Codes- International Taxation Charge](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/pan/2019-015-TIN-Annexure_3-International_AO_Code_Master_version_4.2.xlsx)
  * [PAN AO Codes- Other than International Taxation Charge (Mumbai Region)](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/pan/PAN_AO_Code_Master_\(Mumbai%20region\)_Version%204.3.xlsx)

  * [AO Codes for Pune Region](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/pan/AO%20CODE%20for%20Pune%20Region.zip)

Note : International Taxation AO Code Master Version 4.2 communicated vide circular no. NSDL/TIN/2019/015 dated November 18, 2019 remains unchanged.
